How do viruses enter cells? What is the biophysics behind it?
epsin · clathrin · virus
Influenza A entry imaging · Joseph et al., Membranes 2022 (doi:10.3390/membranes12090859)
Viral entry is a biophysics problem: an orchestration model is needed to identify which protein players — and which specific domains — bend the membrane and commit the pit.
Structure → membrane physics (forward); real super-resolution shape data → mechanics (reverse). A guard refuses any force the data cannot constrain.

    • What the manuscript shows

    Roles from structure

    AlphaFold + pLDDT split adaptors into curvature-driving wedges and size-setting crowders.

    A commitment threshold

    A pit crosses Ω only when a crowding partner and actin force coincide — neither alone suffices.

    Validated & falsifiable

    Curvature program holds across three cell lines; epsin is the adaptor influenza co-opts; force refused where data can't bear it.

    An engine an agent can drive
    Connected to Claude, Mechanome becomes a hypothesis loop: hand it a movie and a question in plain language, get back a calibrated answer or an honest UNDETERMINED with the exact experiment to run next — closing the loop on mechanobiology problems end to end.
